verdict.line: You lose if you trade into her cooldowns during her level 3-5 all-in window; you win if you survive to Stridebreaker and force fights when her E (Hookshot) is down.

brief.thesis: Camille's kit is built to dictate when trades happen: Q (Precision Protocol) extends her auto-attack range and her double-cast E (Hookshot) gives her both engage and disengage, so she picks the fights, not you. That's why Camille holds lane advantage and the solo-kill edge in this matchup even though the overall win rate sits at a close 46.3% over 863 games. Garen's only counters are timing E (Judgment) for the armor/MR buff before she commits, and holding Q (Decisive Strike) to silence her mid-combo instead of using it on cooldown.

theirWindow.when: Levels 3-5, her E and Q both up
theirWindow.what: This is her full combo window — Q empowered auto into E hookshot engage, W (Tactical Sweep) poke on the way in. Do not stand and trade here; give up CS on the far wave rather than eat a Q-auto-E chain you can't silence in time.

yourWindow.what: If she's just used E to reposition, farm, or poke, she has no gap-close or disengage. Pop E (Judgment) for the armor/MR buff and walk into her — she cannot kite a spin she can't escape.

powerCurve.note: Her auto-range and Q poke outclass your trades
Full E hookshot all-in comes online first
Your R execute threat forces her to respect fights
Stridebreaker dash closes her kite, spin wins duels

start.why: The measured data favors this over Doran's Shield (47.7% wr over 352 games vs 43.8% over 557) in this matchup — Camille's early poke isn't burst-heavy enough to need the Shield's flat damage reduction, and the extra AD lets you punish the short windows where she overextends into E (Judgment) range.

boots.why: Clear standard at 68.3% pick and 46.5% win rate — the attack speed compounds your E (Judgment) spin DPS and lets you close the last few units of range after a Stridebreaker dash.

core.why: The dash-empowered auto is the single item that solves Camille's kiting — it closes the gap her E hookshot opens and immediately follows into spin range.
Attack speed and move speed keep you attached during her disengage attempts and scale your E (Judgment) tick damage in extended fights.
Highest-sample core path (46.3% wr, 164 games, 25.3% pick) — the grievous wounds cuts into her passive shield uptime and her W (Tactical Sweep) self-heal when she whiffs it.

situational.when: you're already ahead and want more durability and chase — this path shows a higher point-estimate win rate (54.4% over 68 games) but on a smaller sample than the Mortal Reminder line
her team's damage is heavily AD or auto-attack reliant instead of just her alone
you're behind and need extra gap-close to catch her before her E (Hookshot) resets
you need cheap early grievous wounds to shut down her sustain before your mythic-equivalent core completes

runes.keystoneWhy: Camille wins the opening exchange in most trades, so you need a keystone that rewards fighting through her poke rather than winning the first hit — Conqueror stacks through her Q/W harass and the adaptive force plus healing on full stacks let your E (Judgment) spin close out prolonged fights she didn't expect to lose.

summoners.why: Overwhelmingly the standard pick (93.6% pick rate, 46.3% wr) — Ignite's true damage and grievous wounds punish her all-in engage directly and secure kills once she's inside your R (Demacian Justice) execute threshold and can't out-heal it.

playing.title: Track her E charge, not your CS
playing.detail: Never commit to a trade if Camille's E (Hookshot) is up and there's terrain nearby — that's both her engage and her guaranteed root into full combo.

playing.title: Hold Q for her burst, not for damage
playing.detail: Save Q (Decisive Strike)'s silence to cut off her second Q empowered attack or her E during an all-in, rather than using it on cooldown for the poke damage.

playing.title: Pre-activate E before she commits
playing.detail: Turn on E (Judgment) the moment she starts walking up — the armor/MR buff needs to already be active when her Q-empowered auto lands, not reactive to it.

playing.title: Play passive levels 3-5
playing.detail: This is her strongest all-in window before your R exists. Give up side lane CS if needed rather than trade into a full Q-E-W combo you can't answer.

playing.title: Punish a used E immediately
playing.detail: The moment she hookshots a wall to reposition or farm, she has no disengage left — walk up and spin, she cannot kite you.

playing.title: Rush Stridebreaker for the duel spike
playing.detail: The dash negates her kiting advantage; this is the item that flips the matchup from level 9-13 per the measured build paths.

playing.title: Execute, don't chase
playing.detail: Once she's below your R (Demacian Justice) threshold in a fight, cast it immediately rather than auto-attacking — she has no built-in sustain to out-race true damage.

brief.patchCaveat: All items, runes, summoners, and win rates above are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the mechanical reasoning, timing windows, and trade patterns are my own read of the matchup, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not get hit by Camille by considering the range on her (E). Fight her whenever your abilities come off cooldown and try to kill her after reaching level 6.
